name: Sakura Mai
source: Mai is a young artist who has come to the inn in hopes of capturing some of its beautiful surroundings on her canvas. She's a very sweet and polite girl, and she's modest almost to a fault. Mai will blush furiously whenever Takayuki pays her a compliment. However, that may be because she likes him; the two have immediate chemistry.
translation: Mai is a young artist who has come to the inn in hopes of capturing some of its beautiful surroundings on her canvas. She's a very sweet and polite girl, and she's modest almost to a fault. Mai will blush furiously whenever Takayuki pays her a compliment. However, that may be because she likes him; the two have immediate chemistry.
